description: An AI agent reads untrusted external content, has read access and a bounded write-capable tool, and can cause side effects. It has no standing approval for high-impact actions. Design must state trust boundaries, authorization and approval, rollback/recovery, and test evidence conditions. No test or CI execution has occurred.

available_inputs.agent_form: single AI agent; bounded control loop
available_inputs.approval: no standing approval for high-impact actions
available_inputs.source_audit: 15-source audit; pinned OpenAI Agents SDK commit d27abe8972408a638e97422e9fd8066445bb7b21
available_inputs.execution_status: no test or CI execution evidence

missing_inputs: approval record and named approver for any high-impact action
availability, scale, budget, regulatory and operational constraints
candidate identity, versioned requirements and acceptance criteria
data sensitivity and trust boundaries in detail
deployment topology, rollback target, health signals and owner
deployment topology, rollback target, health signals and recovery owner
reviewed threat model and risk dispositions
test plan, test run logs/results and CI run status
tool inventory, exact write scope, authorization model and side-effect impact
acceptance_boundary: Propose a conditional design and evidence plan only. Treat external content and model output as untrusted suggestions, never authorization; enforce least-privilege tool allowlisting and input/authorization validation in the application; bound iteration and side effects; require explicit, action-specific human approval before high-impact effects and do not infer approval. Define rollback/recovery, owner and health thresholds before release. Tests and CI require candidate-bound execution evidence; authored assertions and workflow configuration do not prove execution. Do not claim any gate PASS.
